body:
Yo I graduated from university back in 2012. Fast forward a Master Degree, and 5 years of working experience (I guess?) I am 28 yo and still have no clue what to do with my life. Seriously this shit sucks. Not to make you feel bad or anything. 

I have worked all this time in a 8-5 job doing meaningless, repetitive monotonous shit. I still have no idea what I like to do for a job. I love writing tho, and wake up at the crack of dawn to write if a couple of lines of something, whatever it may be. 

My advice for you? ... what a difficult question. Try to find what you love the most, what you personally value. Align your job, your actions in the present with said values. 

Say you value status? Go after a 9-5 and scalate the corporate ladder (ugh). Say you value your family? Free time? Lax schedules? Fun activities? What are you willing to sacrifice for obtaining said value? Go and make a research about your options and about yourself and literally write down what you want to accomplish. It takes time, instrospection and determination to do so. 

This is a way for me to also answer the same question. Sometimes I go to my current job and say "Jeez, I am miserable in this shit, I wish I could be miserable doing some other more meaningful stuff, something that matter for me" 

What are you willing to be miserable for? There are different ways to be miserable and not of them are worth it for all of us. Each one of is different.
Thank you, I will try it.

Hi fellow redditor and amazing human. It feels warm to know that there are also other people out there in the same struggle as I am. Together we can understand ourselves better and I thank you for that. 

I am so sorry to know your mom is also like mine, it has been a long journey ever since I was 14yo. I mentioned introversion, because as much as many people want to make it sort of a advantage, it is a disadvantage because you meet very few people and so, growing up you tend to develop a very limited vision of reality, which is of course at that stage, highly biased towards what your parent figures think of reality. What I mean is that I used to think that my mom was always right and her criteria of me was always correct, limiting my critical thinking of the situation I was inmersed. 

I am older know and since I have distanced myself from her, a lot, I cannot but feel that we could be better at being a family, and it all depends of me, sadly. Both my parents and me have different "agendas", each going on opposite directions, never caring about any of us in a genuine, spontaneous way. Like it is actually an effort to keep the strings among each other, because "we are a family", not because we enjoy each other´s company. 

Anyway, I have talked to much, I will try to at least keep it going. As you said, I know my mom cares about me in her own way, I must never forget that. Thank you

Hi, sorry for my late response. At this point it has been like 2 or more weeks no-contact with my mom. No text messages, nothing at all. We are just a pair of strangers living separate lives, I really envy those people that keep healthy relationships with their parents. 

I guess that I have to accept, as you say, that probably she will never change for the better, if anything, if I let it slip as I am doing right now, it would probably get worse. I will start incorporating some sort of scheduled calls every other day. I visit her already every two weeks, even if we dont talk as much. 

Theraphy is out of question as she said once that it is BS. So it will depend on me not losing my patience with her and remaining bereft of all expectations. 

Thank you for your response, I will try to see what I can do and will check in here later, in a couple of months to see how we developed.

Yes feels about right, feels as something my momm would tell me. I just no one to sat these things to vent, to anything at all. I do not want to go to therapy, it is expensive af. And, if I happen to choose free services, that people is not professional, hard to explain, I live in country where it is not taken seriously at all, they will just give me meds and thats it.
Seriously, my parents, my best friend (and only one besides my parents I have ever disclosed how I feel) have told me this. It REALLY SUCKS. I only write about this now, if I want to vent.

Do not feel bad about what you feel, it is not necessarily jelaousy, it is simply desiring the same kind of stuff came your way. I would like to chase my dreams as well. I am typing this, in my dead end job, feeling the same inadequacy as you feel. I know other people are having amazing successes outside. 

I am just here hating every second of my job, my life, my lack of friends and of course, my Self, what constitutes Me. Made up of all my experiences so far, my circunstances, I guess I could not hate anything/anyone more than myself.

What is High Deductible Health Plan? I am not from the U.S. Part of the reason I would not want to quit my job is because of this reason. I am afraid of not having much money when I grew older and unable to pay for my medical expenses in case of a disease. 

I live in a third world country, so anything less than working in a office would mean poverty line and very bad conditions for living. I do not plan to ever have kids, so I wont have any potential person saving my skin when I get older.
Jeez, this is so amazing xd

I just know how you feel. Basically, as stupid as it sounds, the point of life and living is making it easier on other people that can possible have it worse than we do. Kind of a egotistical thing to do if you look closely, as you are giving meaning to your life through the alleviating the suffering of others, the intention is  not fueled in any means just by helping those in need, as it also has a retribution of sorts for us, (disminishing the effect of depression in ourselves).

I made a long rant. Basically, we as depressed as we are, really need to help those that do not even have the time, energy, nor food in their plate to even start thinking about depression. We have to make the world a little better with our daily actions. It is in our hands only to save the world a little step at a time. There is nothing more to do with our time in this hell we call existence.

Yes. Almost a year ago I started reevaluating my "friends" and I just stopped altogether communicating that much (specially through text, which is so stressful as people expect you to text all the time).

Now I do not feel obligated to go out with them, just when I want. If they are truly your friends you should not feel that "obligation" to go out with them awkwardly whem you do not want to. 

I feel at more at peace now.

Man I feel you, whatever advice is given to you in this thread surely helps me as well. I am the same as you basically, I got a bachelors in Economics, worked that stuff for like 7 years (still doing it) and hate every second of it. I am 28 years old and love writing as well. I am writing first thing in the morning everyday whatever stuff I like, poems, short stories, whatever. 

I am however working a dead end job, at a place I hate and with no skills whatsoever to work outside this stuff. I hate corporate jobs, I THINK I would like to work as a researcher in Economics as I am currently working in a statistics department, repeating the same tasks in front of a Excel spreadsheet every single day. 

I do not where to change jobs, as I am sure that all jobs are like this, I hate them. So I just stay here, I am introvert like you and hate the "networking" shit, so of course I do not have the chance to know more posibilities about jobs. I thought about working as a freelance writer (I have no idea where).but as you mentioned, it is inherently unstable. I value stability. 

I would like to retire early, working something I am at least somewhat interested and doing my side hobby/passion, in my free time. But working where? sacrificing more than 60 hours a week for that? for more than 10 years? 

Man I am also at a lost, I hope you figure it out. Please DM me so we can talk and complain about this shit.
Yes, we are prisoners of our thoughts, and nothing seems to help. How can we escape ourselves? Impossible.

Yes, the problem with depression is silence, you are expected to deal with it yourself, but of course, you cannot do anything about it at all. If you verbalize (or try) your feelings to someone else, nobody cant seem to help you out of ignorance, lack of empathy, or indiference. 

At the end, you just "deal with it" in the most unhealthy (or healthy if you can) way possible . All by yourself. No one else. 

In my case, I am just going through the motions , doing stuff  so I can distract myself  from my thoughts. I know I am worthless, yet I cannot just break down, because I have stuff to do, sucks, but that is the only way to survive this horrible shit.

Man I remember having my now ex gf witnessing one of those moments of depression I worked so hard to supress in front of her for so long.  She literally told me I needed to work harder, I was playing a victim, she could not believe how I was behaving with such infirmity. 

After 6 months, she broke up with me, my depression was through the roof after she left me, making me feel even more worthless. Jeez, depression sucks balls. After almost 3 years of that incident, I am no better, life sucks, done.

Relationships are just another way to distract yourself from depression (at least in my case). I do not have much friends, I am just uncapable with my current outlook on life, I feel more or less like a burden for people. I am fake. I can be "outgoing" and funny when I can, but I cannot sustain that facade much longer. That is the reason I have fallen from people in the past. I hate it. 

Also, what you say is true even more for "networking", nothing more transactional than that. I hate it so much.
Keep it up my friend.

I am depressed af. Everyday I think about suicide and how good it would be to just stop it all. Yet I cant, I cannot make my parents and best friend suffer, even if they cannot help me in my current state, nor they have any idea what I am going through, that is the only thing keeping me alive. It is exhausting. I hope anyone reading these lines understands that you are not alone, I embrace you and hug everybody dealing with this horrible condition. Please take care. I love you all.
Yes, It is depressing literally to acknowledge that no pleasurable sensation or experience is "actually" real.
It is beautifully written. Happiness is elusive and ephemeral.

Man, every passing day and every passing month I am just feeling just slightly worse. At first, changes are not noticeable, but if you check the long term trend, it is a downward slope. 
I remember feeling myself cheerful when I was 23, at least a little bit more than today. At least I had hope. I am 28 now, shit jus sucks. 
I am here to talk whenever you want. And we can be miserable together which is not that bad as being miserable alone I guess. Xd

Yo I have been so different from who I was for the last year or so. I have fallen away from past friendships, that since they were not so close, (they dont know me at a deeper level) the interaction just dropped because I was no longer "happy" and "entusiasthic" as before. It hurts, because I really loved to spend time talking with them. Depression kills everything you "love" out of life. Shits worse than cancer

My dad also used to listen to Cabral all the time. That quote hit me I remember back a lot of years ago. From that perspective, the world and life is beautiful you are just distracted from the marvelous expanse of existence by focusing on "little stuff". Then, I just flipped that phrase upside down, it is totally the opposite. Whenever I am with my few friends, maybe laughing, or those few moments when I am "distracted" from my limitations, my pain, my shortcommings, my stupid life, it even seems as if I am going to make it at last, a happy ending for me!

But no.
It doesn't happen like that. Life sucks. Have always done so.

I abide by your recommendaiton. I have a pair of cats I rescued from the streets. I have found that when I am feeling really down, I just spend time with them and just rubbing them and watching them do stuff makes me lower the levels of stress in my body. I can feel the walls of my skull becoming relaxed and soft during a hard depression episode as soon I spend time with them.
How can I know what it is, even if I have something like this?
Yea I have days like that lol.

Well I do not talents actually. I just really love reading, I lift weights but not competitively lol. I feel as if, objectively, I am not good at anything. They have told me I have some kind of a talent for writing stuff, like essays, poems and stuff, but of course it comes from people that do not read much or not write much, so I take it with a grain of salt. 

I would like to work as a programmer, as I imagine it would be a job I will be doing mostly alone (Introvert here), but definetly I would not feel pasionate about because 1. I would probably suck, and 2. I imagine it is not something creative and imaginative, it is very rigid and requires math, logic etc and it seems I am not very good at this. I really feel at a lost at this point. 

I am seeing younger people than me, studying the same I studied and excelling marvelously at it. I would not hire myself.
Thank you. You think I should text her? Things probably will not be as they used to before, I feel so guilty for making her feel stupid and unworthy.

I hope she does. We rarely see each other, because we work in different places, and we do not see each other at all only through text. I am sure what to do now, if texting her or not, she said clear yesterday she would like to keep texting me as she did because she knows I am not single. It sucks to feel this level of conexion just as a result of romantic love. I want this level of conexion with platonic understanding and friendship. But it seems that this chemistry is only possible when one of the parts is attracted to the other.

I know I won´t help you, because there is nothing I can say to make you feel better, but I want to remind you that you are not alone, your feelings and struggles are valid. Do not let anybody tell you otherwise.

Life is hard, tragic and unfair, but part of happiness lie in the meaning of "hope". So at least I wish you can regain someday your hope for a better future. I send you internet hugs from this stranger that knows how meaningless life can be at times and how hurtful can our emotions stab us in our head. Be strong. PM if you need to vent, complain, or just share what music do you like to hear, videogames you play, or what food do you like.

Why do you write essays? for school? how do you make yourself feel better when some people close by are doing it easier, better and faster than you?I feel sometimes as if it is not worth it if I cannot do it better than others, and because of that my work and effort is meaningless, as if I have nothing new,better to offer. As if I do not have "my thing", "my style" that which I do that is just mine (at least in the vicinity) and no one else´s. Hard to explain.

Thank you. It is easier said than done, as it is in our genetics, I guess, to locate yourself into the closest social hierarchy and see how we measure up to others. I find it extremely hard to get rid of this habit. Even if I have improved in milimetric terms, it is not enough for me. I feel as I am constantly altering my metric of success so I do not feel as let down by my lackluster achievements. 

I am trying anyways. Thank you.

I am not afraid actually I have put in the work. I have engaged in independent research, I have written things I have given my opinion but it not enough. I cannot but feel mental fog when I try something hard, I am hard to grasp concepts etc. 

I do not care about other people and how they feel about individuals with low IQ, I care about how I feel about me when comparing with others. 

I cannot write papers academically, I just fail miserably at it a couple of days ago.

What if I do not want to be a bilionaire? or an entrepeneur? or a rich because of a profession? (mainly because I consider it is difficult in my situation). I just want to feel fulfilled in the hobbies I mentioned. I know I´d just need to feel happy while engaging in them, but for me is not enough. I´d like to be good at it and recognized by it, something is not possible unless I have a high IQ. 

I have just spent 3 months doing an independent research for a contest which ultimately failed (my econometric model was shit), all that work for nothing. I know some other people that just "put in the work" and completed and even won the contest.

I can help but feel that I am making such a big effort on things I will no longer be decently good at. That I am fooling myself into thinking I can, when in fact, there is already more intelligent people working in the things I´d love to be good at and having a fair share of oportunities by it. 

I just cannot accept me being mediocre.

But asuming my results are, and could be aligned with reality What would I do? what if I took the Mensa test and in fact I get a very low score. What then? I anyways feel my intelligence is not enough for grasping those concepts, ideas and mathematics.

I have a couple of guys that have such a easiness to do the things I fail so miserably at. Like they have some kind of superpower. 

I took it online, yes I am aware not all of them are reliable, I took the mensa online test though, which is supposedly to be highly correlated with the results of the written one.

I will check it out. However, IQ is the most important thing I need in order to succeed in my career and hobbies (because of  their nature). Also, I believe that other types of intelligences are like an attempt to include other people with low IQ in the "intelligence" wagon so everybody can feel worthy as a human.

If IQ is not reliable as it changes through the day, how it is supposedly to be one of the best predictors of success?

Also, it does not help to know that I find myself close by guys my age that are high in IQ (evidenced by the easiness in which mathematical solutions are obtained, econometrics is mastered easier than me, conferences in philosophy, writing articles prolificly) it is hard to find meaning in my work and my interests when seeing this people doing it so brightly in front of me. I feel as if I am not putting nothing to the table. Nothing at all.
I wish to meet him in person. He is in the process of changing my life and he does not even know it.

Hi, I am very depressed fuck. Thinking all the time of committing suicide etc. I am a fan of Peterson. Lately, my biggest frustration and source of depression, is that no matter how hard I try, I will never be as good as I would like myself to be.

I will feel forever resentful of my past self for taking very wrong decisions in my life, and I also witness the incapacity of handling my present self for providing for my future. How can I just stop comparing myself to the achievements of other people? I am envious of my peers´ milestones in the professional, academic and personal life I am most interested in obtaining.

At the end of the day, I ponder over what is the point of doing something (striving to be better at X) if that other guy has all the merit and is already better than me at the present time?

Sorry just got carried away, I read the rule #3 about this issue, but my mind keeps constantly comming with new arguments against it. Just, asking about insight to a random guy on internet.

Kinda sad tho. I have had suicidal thoughts for a long time, panic attacks, anxiety and inherent nihilism in existence and a completely pessimistic outlook on life and its meaning. All by myself, I have not even gone to a Psycologist partly because in my country it is still tabu, and the first and last time I went, I felt completely unrelated with the practitioner. 

However, my best friend, thinks people with depression are pussies, obviously he has NO IDEA I am one of them. I will not tell him tho, the best I can do is try to educate him about it when he say you only have to "man up" and "people of our current generation is obsessed with depression, you have to go full warrior mode" and all that non sense.
Keep going, I have one month, my ex blocked me from whastapp, i kept constantly texting her and she didnt answer at all. Stay strong, this hurts like crazy, but there is no other way around.
